# Blend › Luma Dissolve

**What belongs here.** The image's own brightness decides which pixels change first.

**Examples.** highlights-first dissolve

**Family test.** Is every pixel a weighted mix of A and B (or a flat colour), with no moving boundary?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Luma Dissolve](luma-dissolve/) | Scene A dissolves by its own brightness: its highlights vanish first and its shadows last, showing scene B behind. |
